rejection_reasons: The run predates the mass-conservative post-collision Guo wall-traction source and does not record that scheme, so its absolute resistance is legacy-physics evidence only.
All three stationarity measures exceed the one-percent target.
The surface-pressure observer differs from the independent control-volume force by more than five percent.
The mean resistance differs from the experiment by 39.85 percent.
The very high measured exchange y+ supports the active L720 near-wall refinement study but is not itself an accuracy correction.
component_inference: The legacy run's wall-shear component is already 91.56 percent of the total experimental resistance, while its pressure component is 48.46 percent of the total experiment. This points to pressure recovery, effective outer-flow Reynolds number, geometry resolution and AMR-interface sensitivity as the next causal checks; it does not authorize subtracting either component empirically.
required_follow_up: Use v13 with the corrected wall source for the clean no-inlet-sponge baseline.
Compare v13 against the concurrently running corrected-source v14 inlet-sponge trajectory.
Do not combine v33 with corrected-source grid convergence.
Record pressure and wall-shear means separately in all corrected-source results.
After four-level long-time stability is established, test higher resolved collision Reynolds with viscosity continuation rather than tuning resistance.
